lines.text: Four kids, one phone, zero quiet!
I'm losing it with all this noise.

data.define: Used when you are losing control of your feelings.

example.text: I'm losing it with all this noise.

misuse.text: Don't tell your boss 'I'm losing it' casually.

hook.text: Four kids, one phone, zero quiet!

publish.title: What does "losing it" mean?
publish.value: Losing it = I can't stay calm anymore. Example: "I'm losing it with all this noise." (casual English).
